messages:
sam-sales: Heads-up: RegionalBank asked if we can run an air-gapped POC with signed incremental patches, no outbound calls, and documented rollback. They also want pricing and upgrade cadence in the SOW.

tina-solutions: Good to know. Two clarifications: do they require customer-held signing keys (HSM) or is our signed bundle + attestation ok? Also prefer delta minibundles or full-image swaps?

hiro-eng: We support chunked minibundles (delta-friendly) and full-image swaps. Minibundle manifest is signed with Notary v2 by default; can accept customer pubkey for signature verification.

leah-security: We can support customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) and provide a key-injection runbook. If they require FIPS HSM, note extra onboarding steps and attestation reports.

ops-engr: Offline delivery is straightforward: we produce a self-contained tar.gz plus bundle.sha256 and signed manifest. No network calls during apply. Verify snippet: `sha256sum -c bundle.sha256 && ./verify-manifest --key bank.pub bundle.sig`.

tina-solutions: Upgrade cadence: propose quarterly deltas + emergency hotfix SLA (48-72h). Pricing: POC eng ~$28k; offline bundle subscription (4 deltas/yr + signing support) ~$18k/yr. Customer HSM integration: one-time $6k.

sam-sales: Legal asks: any outbound telemetry in offline bundles?

hiro-eng: None. We strip metrics and disable probes for offline builds. Only local apply logs remain.

leah-security: One-liner for questionnaire: "Yes 	6 Redwood supports customer-managed signing keys (HSM/KMS) for offline bundle signing; see attached key-injection runbook."

sam-sales: @deploy-bot open POC ticket with tags: offline, customer-hsm, quarterly-patches.

deploy-bot: Created POC ticket RB-POC-2026-155. Assigned to hiro-eng. ETA initial artifact: 6 business days.

sam-sales: I'll include pricing and the security one-liner in the proposal. I'll ping if procurement wants encrypted bundles or specific key delivery methods. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
